#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized native binary at ./app using only the OCaml compiler.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

build_dir=_build
rm -rf "$build_dir"
mkdir -p "$build_dir"
cp src/lru.mli src/lru.ml src/main.ml "$build_dir"/

(
  cd "$build_dir"
  flags=(-unsafe -inline 200)
  if ocamlopt -config | grep -q '^flambda: true'; then
    flags+=(-O3)
  fi
  ocamlopt "${flags[@]}" -o app lru.mli lru.ml main.ml
)

mv "$build_dir/app" ./app

(** A fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache from string keys to string
    values. All operations run in O(1) expected time. *)

type t

val create : int -> t
(** [create capacity] returns an empty cache holding at most [capacity] keys.
    @raise Invalid_argument if [capacity < 1]. *)

val set : t -> string -> string -> unit
(** Insert or overwrite a binding and mark it most recently used, evicting the
    least recently used binding if the capacity is exceeded. *)

val get : t -> string -> string option
(** Look up a key; a hit marks it most recently used. *)

val remove : t -> string -> bool
(** Remove a key, returning whether it was present. *)

val size : t -> int

(* Reads a capacity and a stream of cache commands from stdin, writing one
   line of output per GET, DEL and SIZE command. *)

let strip_cr line =
  let n = String.length line in
  if n > 0 && line.[n - 1] = '\r' then String.sub line 0 (n - 1) else line

let run_command cache out line =
  match String.split_on_char ' ' line with
  | [ "SET"; key; value ] -> Lru.set cache key value
  | [ "GET"; key ] ->
      Buffer.add_string out
        (match Lru.get cache key with Some v -> v | None -> "NULL");
      Buffer.add_char out '\n'
  | [ "DEL"; key ] ->
      Buffer.add_string out (if Lru.remove cache key then "1\n" else "0\n")
  | [ "SIZE" ] ->
      Buffer.add_string out (string_of_int (Lru.size cache));
      Buffer.add_char out '\n'
  | _ -> () (* Blank or malformed lines are ignored. *)

let flush_threshold = 1 lsl 16

let () =
  match In_channel.input_line stdin with
  | None -> ()
  | Some first -> (
      match int_of_string_opt (String.trim first) with
      | None ->
          prerr_endline "lru: invalid capacity";
          exit 1
      | Some capacity ->
          let cache = Lru.create (max capacity 1) in
          let out = Buffer.create (2 * flush_threshold) in
          let rec loop () =
            match In_channel.input_line stdin with
            | None -> ()
            | Some line ->
                run_command cache out (strip_cr line);
                if Buffer.length out >= flush_threshold then begin
                  Buffer.output_buffer stdout out;
                  Buffer.clear out
                end;
                loop ()
          in
          loop ();
          Buffer.output_buffer stdout out;
          flush stdout)
